newsitem.title: USA: Apria to settle whistle blower lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Apria to settle whistle blower lawsuit.

text.p: Apria Healthcare Group Inc said it reached an agreement in principle to resolve all of the claims brought against the company in a "whistle blower" lawsuit filed in July 1995.
In a statement, Apria said the suit involved allegations that one of Apria's predecessors, Homedco Group Inc, had improperly compensated certain physicians in exchange for patient referrals.
Settlement documentation is expected to be completed by year-end, following receipt of final government approvals.

Under the terms of the agreement, Apria would admit no liability and would pay the government approximately $1.65 million. In return, the government, which had intervened to prosecute certain claims, and the original plaintiff, a former Homedco employee, would agree to a complete dismissal of the lawsuit.
